command.name: abs
command.description: The absolute value of x.

command.name: accTime
command.description: Returns the current time acceleration factor.

command.name: acos
command.description: The arccosine of x, the result is in degrees.

command.name: action
command.description: Makes the unit peform an action. The format of action can be [type, target, param1, param2, param3]. Only type is required, target defaults to unit and param1, param2, param3 are type specific.

command.name: actionKeys
command.description: Returns a list of dikCodes of buttons assigned to the given user action.

command.name: actionKeysImages
command.description: Returns a list of button images or names assigned to the given user action. A maximum of maxKeys keys is listed. You can find the action names in config class ControllerSchemes.

command.name: actionKeysNames
command.description: Returns a list of button names assigned to the given user action. A maximum of maxKeys keys is listed. You can find the action names in config class ControllerSchemes.

command.name: actionKeysNamesArray
command.description: Returns a list of button names assigned to the given user action. A maximum of maxKeys keys is listed. You can find the action names in config class ControllerSchemes.

command.name: actionName
command.description: Returns localized name of action.

command.name: activateAddons
command.description: Activates the listed addons. The list of active addons is initialized during this function.

command.name: activateKey
command.description: Activates the given key for the current user profile. The keys are used to unlock missions or campaigns. See keys, keysLimit and doneKeys in the description.ext file of the missions.

command.name: addAction
command.roper: [action, script filename(, arguments, priority, showWindow, hideOnUse, shortcut, condition)]
command.description: Creates an action. The action ID should be returned, but due to a bug, it's not. To determine the action ID, use following algorithm: the first action added to the given vehicle has ID zero, the next vehicle has ID one, etc.

command.name: addBackpack
command.description: Adds the backpack to the unit. Note: unit with secondary or two-slot weapon cannot have backpack.

command.name: addCamShake
command.description: Adds camera shake source.

command.name: addClass
command.description: Create new subclass of file or other class. Base will be appended to the class upon saving ie classname : base.

command.name: addClass
command.description: Create new subclass of file or other class.

command.name: addEditorObject
command.description: Add an object to the editor and assign arguments. Create script is called with _new equal to true. Returns the ID of the new EditorObject. Subtype class is optional.

command.name: addEventHandler
command.description: The format of handler is [type,command]. Check scripting topic Event handlers for more information. The index of the currently added handler is returned.

command.name: addLiveStats
command.description: Xbox Live MP only: adds score to the Xbox Live Statistics score for the given unit (or the commander unit of the given vehicle).

command.name: addMagazine
command.description: Adds a magazine to the unit. Note: you may create invalid combinations by using this function, for example by adding 20 grenades. When doing so, application behaviour is undefined.

command.name: addMagazine
command.description: Adds a magazine to the unit and sets ammo count. Note: you may create invalid combinations by using this function, for example by adding 20 grenades. When doing so, application behaviour is undefined.

command.name: addMagazineCargo
command.description: Adds magazines to the weapon cargo space. This is used for infantry weapons. The format of magazines is [magazineName, count]. For magazineName values see CfgWeapons.

command.name: addMagazineTurret
command.description: Adds a magazine to the turret. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret. Note: you may create invalid combinations by using this function, for example by adding 20 grenades. When doing so, application behaviour is undefined.

command.name: addMenu
command.description: Adds a new menu button. Priority is optional.

command.name: addMenuItem
command.description: Creates a new menu item. Menu can be "file" or "view", index is index as returned from addMenu command. priority is optional and determines where in the menu the item will reside (higher priority items first).

command.name: addMissionEventHandler
command.description: The format of handler is [type,command]. Check scripting topic Event handlers for more information. The index of the currently added handler is returned.

command.name: addPublicVariableEventHandler
command.description: Create an event handler for given variable. The event handler will be executed when some client in MP exports a variable using publicVariable on all clients except the publishing one.

command.name: addRating
command.description: Adds number to the unit rating. This is usually used to reward for completed mission objectives. The rating for killed enemies and killed friendlies is adjusted automatically. When the rating is lower than zero, a unit is considered "renegade" and is an enemy to everyone.

command.name: addResources
command.description: Add (register) resources to the team member.

command.name: addScore
command.description: MP only: adds unit score. This is shown in the "I" MP screen as the total score.

command.name: addTeamMember
command.description: Add given member to given team.

command.name: addValue
command.description: Add new value to file or class. Supported types of value are: strings, numbers and arrays (even arrays of arrays ...)

command.name: addWeapon
command.description: Adds the weapon to the unit. Note: you may create invalid combinations by using this function, for example by adding two rifles. When doing so, application behaviour is undefined.

command.name: addWeaponCargo
command.description: Adds weapons to the weapon cargo space. This is used for infantry weapons. The format of weapons is [weaponName, count]. For weaponName values see CfgWeapons.

command.name: agent
command.description: Return a person for given agent.

command.name: agents
command.description: Return a list of agents in the current mission.

command.name: aimedAtTarget
command.description: Returns how good is weapon aimed to target.
command.example: bool = vehicle AimedAtTarget [target]; bool = vehicle AimedAtTarget [target,1]

command.name: aimPos
command.description: Returns the position of the object other units can aim to in format PositionASL.

command.name: airportSide
command.description: Checks a side of the airport.

command.name: airTemperature
command.description: Return the current air temperature.

command.name: alive
command.description: Checks whether the given person, vehicle or building is't dead / destroyed.

command.name: allDead
command.description: Return a list of dead units and destroyed vehicles. Dead unit might be inside vehicle.,

command.name: allMissionObjects
command.description: Returns all mission objects with given type.

command.name: allow3DMode
command.description: Allow/dissallow 3D mode.

command.name: allowCrewInImmobile
command.description: If true, units can be in vehicle with broken tracks/wheels.

command.name: allowDamage
command.description: Obsolete.

command.name: allowDammage
command.description: Obsolete.

command.name: allowFileOperations
command.description: Allow/dissallow file ops (load/save etc).

command.name: ammo
command.description: Counts how many shots the unit has left for the given magazine type.

command.name: and
command.description: a and b
command.example: alive player and alive leader player

command.name: animate
command.description: Process animation on object. Animation is defined in config file. Wanted animation phase is set to phase.

command.name: animationPhase
command.description: Return animation phase of animation on object.

command.name: animationState
command.description: Return the name of the current primary animation.

command.name: armoryPoints
command.description: Return the stored value of armory points.

command.name: asin
command.description: The arcsine of x, the result is in degrees.

command.name: ASLToATL
command.description: Converts a position from PositionASL to Position format.

command.name: assert
command.description: Tests a condition and if the condition is false, halts the program.

command.name: assignedTarget
command.description: Return the target assigned to the vehicle.

command.name: assignToAirport
command.description: Set airport to be used by AI on getout

command.name: atan
command.description: The arctangens of x, the result is in degrees.

command.name: atan2
command.description: Returns the arctangens of x/y. The returned value is in degrees, in the range from -180 to +180, using the signs of both parameters to determine the quadrant of the returned value.

command.name: atg
command.description: The arctangens of x, the result is in degrees.

command.name: ATLToASL
command.description: Converts a position from Position to PositionASL format.

command.name: attachedObject
command.description: Return object attached to given location.

command.name: attachObject
command.description: Attach a object to given location.

command.name: attachTo
command.description: Attaches an object to another object. The offset is applied to the object center unless a memory point is provided.

command.name: behaviour
command.description: Returns the behaviour mode of the given unit ("CARELESS","SAFE","AWARE","COMBAT" or "STEALTH").

command.name: benchmark
command.description: Returns the value of "3D performance" as it is in OFP preferences. This can be used to estimate computer performance. The function can be used to create missions that are able to adapt to computer peformance.

command.name: boundingBox
command.description: Returns a bounding box of given object in model coordinates space. The result is in format [[minX, minZ, minY], [maxX, maxZ, maxY]].

command.name: boundingCenter
command.description: Returns the position of original (loaded) center of object in model coordinates. The result is in format [x, z, y]

command.name: breakOut
command.description: Breaks block out scope named 'name'. Nil is returned.

command.name: breakTo
command.description: Breaks block to scope named 'name'. Nil is returned.

command.name: buildingExit
command.description: Returns the given indexed exit in a building. The returned value is in format Position.

command.name: buildingPos
command.description: Returns the given indexed position in a building. The returned value is in format Position.

command.name: buttonAction
command.description: Returns the action assigned to the control with id idc of the topmost user dialog. The action is any expression in this scripting language. The function can be used for buttons and active texts.

command.name: buttonAction
command.description: Returns the action assigned to the given button or active text. The action is any expression in this scripting language.

command.name: buttonSetAction
command.description: Assigns an action to the control with id idc of the topmost user dialog. Action is any expression in this scripting language. The function can be used for buttons and active texts.

command.name: buttonSetAction
command.description: Assigns an action to the given button or active text. Action is any expression in this scripting language.

command.name: cadetMode
command.description: Returns true if the mission is played in cadet mode and false in veteran mode.

command.name: call
command.description: Executes the given code.

command.name: call
command.description: Executes the function body. Argument pars is passed as _this.

command.name: callExtension
command.description: Execute an extension function

command.name: camCommand
command.description: Executes a command on the given camera / actor object. The "manual on" and "manual off" commands are recognized for all types. For the "camera" type, the following commands can be used: "inertia on" and "inertia off". For the "seagull" type it's one of: "landed" and "airborne".

command.name: camCommit
command.description: Commits the camera changes smoothly over time. A time of zero results in an immediate change.

command.name: camCommitPrepared
command.description: Commits the prepared camera changes smoothly over time. A time of zero results in an immediate change.

command.name: camCommitted
command.description: Checks whether the camera has finished committing.

command.name: camConstuctionSetParams
command.description: Sets construction camera parameters.

command.name: camCreate
command.description: Creates a camera or an actor of the given type on the given initial position (format Position). Its type is one of "CAMERA" or "SEAGULL".

command.name: camDestroy
command.description: Destroys the camera.

command.name: cameraEffect
command.description: Switches the camera to the given vehicle / camera. The format of effect is [name, position]. Name is one of: "Internal", "External", "Fixed" or "FixedWithZoom". Position is one of: "TOP", "LEFT", "RIGHT", "FRONT" or "BACK" ("BACK" is normally used).

command.name: cameraEffectEnableHUD
command.description: Enable / disable showing of in-game UI during currently active camera effect.

command.name: cameraInterest
command.description: Return camera interest for given entity.

command.name: cameraOn
command.description: Returns the vehicle to which the camera is attached.

command.name: cameraView
command.description: Return type of camera.

command.name: camPreload
command.description: Preload the scene for he prepared camera. Time gives timeout, zero means no (infinite) timeout.

command.name: camPreloaded
command.description: Checks whether the camera has finished preloading.

command.name: camPrepareBank
command.description: Prepares the camera bank angle. See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareDir
command.description: Prepares the camera heading. See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareDive
command.description: Prepares the camera dive angle. See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareFocus
command.description: focusRange is in format [distance,blur]. Prepares the camera focus blur. See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareFov
command.description: Prepares the camera field of view (zoom). See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareFovRange
command.description: Prepares the camera field of view range for auto zooming. See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPreparePos
command.description: Prepares the camera position (format Position). See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareRelPos
command.description: Prepares the camera position relative to the current position of the currect target (see camPrepareTarget). See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareTarget
command.description: Prepares the camera target to a position (format Position). See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareTarget
command.description: Prepares the camera target. See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camSetBank
command.description: Sets the camera bank angle. It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetDir
command.description: Sets the camera heading. It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetDive
command.description: Sets the camera dive angle. It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetFocus
command.description: focusRange is in format [distance,blur]. Sets the camera focus blur. It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetFov
command.description: Sets the camera field of view (zoom). It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetFovRange
command.description: Sets the camera field of view range for auto zooming. It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetPos
command.description: Sets the camera position (format Position). It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetRelPos
command.description: Sets the camera position relative to the current position of the currect target (see camSetTarget). It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetTarget
command.description: Sets the camera target. It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetTarget
command.description: Sets the camera target to a position (format Position). It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camTarget
command.description: Returns camera's target.

command.name: camUseNVG
command.description: Set / clear using of night vision during cutscenes.

command.name: canFire
command.description: Checks whether the given vehicle is able to fire. It does not check for ammo, only for damage.

command.name: canMove
command.description: Checks whether the given vehicle is able to move. It does not test for fuel, only the damage status is checked.

command.name: canStand
command.description: Checks whether the given soldier is able to stand up.

command.name: canUnloadInCombat
command.description: Check if cargo of this vehicle want to get out when in combat.

command.name: captive
command.description: Checks whether the unit is a captive. If the unit is a vehicle, its commander is checked instead.

command.name: captiveNum
command.description: Checks whether the unit is a captive. If the unit is a vehicle, its commander is checked instead.

command.name: case
command.description: see switch

command.name: catch
command.description: processes code, when exception is thrown in try block

command.name: ceil
command.description: The ceil value of x.

command.name: cheatsEnabled
command.description: Checks whether cheats are enabled (whether the designers' version is running).

command.name: checkAIFeature
command.description: Check if given AI feature is currently enabled.

command.name: civilian
command.description: The Civilian side.

command.name: className
command.description: Return short name of location. (used for scripting)

command.name: clearMagazineCargo
command.description: Removes all magazines from the vehicle cargo space.

command.name: clearMagazineCargoGlobal
command.description: Removes all magazines from the vehicle cargo space. MP synchronized.

command.name: clearOverlay
command.description: Clear the current overlay.

command.name: clearRadio
command.description: Clean up the content of radio protocol history.

command.name: clearVehicleInit
command.description: Clear vehicle init field.

command.name: clearWeaponCargo
command.description: Removes all weapons from the vehicle cargo space.

command.name: clearWeaponCargoGlobal
command.description: Removes all weapons from the vehicle cargo space. MP synchronized.

command.name: closeDialog
command.description: Closes the topmost user dialog as if a button with id idc was pressed.

command.name: closeDisplay
command.description: Close given display.

command.name: closeOverlay
command.description: Closes the current overlay without committing.

command.name: collapseObjectTree
command.description: Collapse the object tree.

command.name: commander
command.description: Returns the commander of the vehicle. If the vehicle is not a vehicle, but a person, the person is returned instead.

command.name: comment
command.description: This function does nothing. It's used to create comments.

command.name: commitOverlay
command.description: Commit the current overlay.

command.name: compile
command.description: Compile expression.

command.name: completedFSM
command.description: Check whether the given FSM completes. The FSM handle is the number returned by the execFSM command.

command.name: composeText
command.description: Creates a structured text by joining the given structured or plain texts.
command.example: txt = composeText ["First line", image "data\isniper.paa", lineBreak, "Second line"]

command.name: configFile
command.description: Return root of config entries hierarchy.

command.name: configName
command.description: Returns name of config entry.

command.name: controlNull
command.description: A non-existing control. This value is not equal to anything, including itself.

command.name: copyFromClipboard
command.description: Return the content of the (text) clipboard.

command.name: copyToClipboard
command.description: Copy the text to the clipboard.

command.name: cos
command.description: The cosine of x, the argument is in degrees.

command.name: count
command.description: Returns count of subentries.

command.name: count
command.description: The number of elements in the array.

command.name: count
command.description:
Counts the elements in the array for which the given condition is true.
It is calculated as follows:
1) Set the count to 0. 2) For each element in the array assign an element as _x and evaluate the condition expression. If it's true, increase the count.

command.name: countSide
command.description: Checks how many vehicles belong to the given side.

command.name: countType
command.description: Counts how many vehicles in the array are of the given type. For types see CfgVehicles.

command.name: createAgent
command.description: Creates an (independent) agent (person) of the given type (type is a name of a subclass of CfgVehicles). If the markers array contains several marker names, the position of a random one is used. Otherwise, the given position is used. The unit is placed inside a circle with this position as its center and placement as its radius. Special properties can be: "NONE" and "FORM".

command.name: createDialog
command.description: Creates a user dialog from the resource template name. If a user dialog already exists, it creates a child dialog of the topmost user dialog. The class name is searched in the description.ext file of the mission, the description.ext file of the campaign and the globlal resource.cpp file. The function returns its success.

command.name: createDiaryLink
command.description: Create a link to the section of diary given by subject. Record is selected based on given object (diary record, task or unit).

command.name: createDiaryRecord
command.roper: [subject, text(, task(, state))] or [subject, [title, text](, task(, state))]
command.description: Create a new record in a log.

command.name: createDiarySubject
command.roper: [subject, display name] or [subject, display name, picture]
command.description: Create a new subject page in a log.

command.name: createDisplay
command.description: Create child display of given display and load from resource "name".

command.name: CreateGearDialog
command.description: Opens gear dialog for given unit.

command.name: createInCargo
command.description: Create an item in the cargo space of the entity.

command.name: createInInventory
command.description: Create an item in person's inventory.

command.name: createLocation
command.description: Create location of given type with given size at given position.

command.name: createMarker
command.description: Creates a new marker on the given position. The marker name has to be unique. The marker is created on all computers in a network session.

command.name: createMarkerLocal
command.description: Creates a new marker on the given position. The marker name has to be unique. The marker is only created on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: createMenu
command.description: Creates a previously added menu.

command.name: createMine
command.description: Creates a mine of the given type (type is the name of the subclass of CfgVehicles). If the markers array contains several marker names, the position of a random one is used. Otherwise, the given position is used. The mine is placed inside a circle with this position as its center and placement as its radius.

command.name: createMissionDisplay
command.description: Create single missions display as a child of given display. The mission dialog will be set to the directory given as an argument "root". Mission space defines container's config class name.

command.name: createMissionDisplay
command.description: Create single missions display as a child of given display. The mission dialog will be set to the directory given as an argument "root".

command.name: createSimpleTask
command.description: Create a new simple task (subtask of parentTask).

command.name: createSoundSource
command.description: Creates a sound source of the given type (type is the name of the subclass of CfgVehicles). If the markers array contains several marker names, the position of a random one is used. Otherwise, the given position is used. The sound source is placed inside a circle with this position as its center and placement as its radius.

command.name: createTask
command.roper: [[type] or [type, parentTask], priority, name1, value1, name2, value2, ...]
command.description: Create a new AI task (subtask of parentTask). Type is name of registered task type.

command.name: createTeam
command.description: Create a team and name it.

command.name: createTrigger
command.description: Creates a new trigger on the given position. An object of the given type is created; this type must be a class name in CfgNonAIVehicles or CfgVehicles with simulation=detector.

command.name: createVehicle
command.description: Creates a vehicle of the given type (type is the name of the subclass in CfgVehicles). If the markers array contains several marker names, the position of a random one is used. Otherwise, the given position is used. The vehicle is placed inside a circle with this position as center and placement as its radius. Special properties can be: "NONE", "FLY" and "FORM".

command.name: createVehicle
command.description: Creates an empty vehicle of the given type. Pos is in format Position. See CfgVehicles for possible type values.

command.name: createVehicleLocal
command.description: Creates an empty vehicle of the given type. Pos is in format Position. See CfgVehicles for possible type values. Vehicle is not transferred through network in MP games.

command.name: createWeaponAttachment
command.description: Create an item attached to weapon.

command.name: crew
command.description: Returns all units mounted in the given vehicle. If the vehicle is not a vehicle, but person, a list containing only persons is returned.

command.name: ctrlActivate
command.description: Launch actions attached to given (button based) control.

command.name: ctrlAddEventHandler
command.description: Add an event handler to the given control. Returns id of the handler or -1 when failed.

command.name: ctrlAutoScrollDelay
command.description: Returns number of seconds until auto-scroll starts. -2 if scrollbar not present.

command.name: ctrlAutoScrollRewind
command.description: True if auto-scroll should move back to start after it reach end.

command.name: ctrlAutoScrollSpeed
command.description: Returns number of seconds to auto-scroll one line. -1 if auto-scroll is disabled. -2 if scrollbar not present.

command.name: ctrlCommit
command.description: Commit control animation.

command.name: ctrlCommitted
command.description: Check if the control animation is finished.

command.name: ctrlEnable
command.description: Enables / disables the control with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: ctrlEnable
command.description: Enable / disable given control.

command.name: ctrlEnabled
command.description: Returns whether the control with id idc of the topmost user dialog is enabled.

command.name: ctrlEnabled
command.description: Returns whether given control is enabled.

command.name: ctrlFade
command.description: Returns the current fade factor of control.

command.name: ctrlHTMLLoaded
command.description: Returns true when HTML content was successfully loaded.

command.name: ctrlMapAnimAdd
command.description: Adds the next frame to the map animation. The format of frame is [time, zoom, position], the format of position is Position2D.

command.name: ctrlMapAnimClear
command.description: Clears the map animation.

command.name: ctrlMapAnimCommit
command.description: Plays the map animation.

command.name: ctrlMapAnimDone
command.description: Checks whether the map animation has finished.

command.name: ctrlMapCursor
command.description: Changes default cursor texture ("Track", "Move","Array", "Scroll") to custom one. To restore default texture, write empty string. If new texture does not exist, default cursor texture is used.

command.name: ctrlMapMouseOver
command.description: Returns description of map sign mouse cursor is over.

command.name: ctrlMapScale
command.description: Return the current scale of the map control.

command.name: ctrlMapScreenToWorld
command.description: Convert position in the map from screen coordinates to world coordinates.

command.name: ctrlMapWorldToScreen
command.description: Convert position in the map from world coordinates to screen coordinates.

command.name: ctrlObject
command.description: Returns object for object based (3D) controls.

command.name: ctrlParent
command.description: Returns container of given control.

command.name: ctrlPosition
command.description: Returns the current position and size of control as [x, y, w, h] array.

command.name: ctrlRemoveAllEventHandlers
command.description: Remove all even handlers from the given control.

command.name: ctrlRemoveEventHandler
command.description: Remove a given event handler from the given control.

command.name: ctrlScale
command.description: Returns the current scale of control.

command.name: ctrlSetActiveColor
command.description: Sets text color of given control when control is selected. Color is in format Color.

command.name: ctrlSetAutoScrollDelay
command.description: Sets number of second before auto-scroll starts.

command.name: ctrlSetAutoScrollRewind
command.description: Defines if scroll should rewind when auto-scroll reach end.

command.name: ctrlSetAutoScrollSpeed
command.description: Sets number of second required to scroll to next line. If speed smaller than 0, auto-scroll is disabled.

command.name: ctrlSetBackgroundColor
command.description: Sets background color of given control. Color is in format Color.

command.description: Sets the team member's combat mode (engagement rules). Mode can be one of: "BLUE" (Never fire), "GREEN" (Hold fire - defend only), "WHITE" (Hold fire, engage at will), "YELLOW" (Fire at will) or "RED" (Fire at will, engage at will).

command.name: setCurrentTask
command.description: Set the task as a current task of the person.

command.name: setDamage
command.description: Damages / repairs the object. Damage 0 means the object is fully functional, damage 1 means it's completely destroyed / dead. Note: this function is identical to setDammage. It was introduced to fix a spelling error in the original function name.

command.name: setDammage
command.description: Damages / repairs the object. Damage 0 means the object is fully functional, damage 1 means it's completely destroyed / dead.

command.name: setDate
command.description: Sets the actual mission date and time.

command.name: setDesiredLuminanceCoef
command.description: Sets coefficient that is used to multiply desired luminance. Set to negative value to use automatic values from light config.

command.name: setDestination
command.description: Set the destination for path planning of the pilot.

command.name: setDetailMapBlendPars
command.description: Sets the detail texture map blend pars.

command.name: setDir
command.description: Sets the object heading. The accepted heading range is from 0 to 360.

command.name: setDirection
command.description: Set a new direction (angle) of given location.

command.name: setDrawIcon
command.roper: [object, texture, color, offset, width, height, maintain size?, angle, string identifier, shadow, is3D, draw line?, priority]
command.description: Set the icon to be shown in 2D editor for the specified editor object. If maintain size is false, icon will not scale depending on the scale of the map. If maintain size is a number, the icon will maintain size if map scale is below that number. is3D, show line and priority are optional.

command.name: setDropInterval
command.description: Set interval of emitting particles from particle source.

command.name: setEditorMode
command.description: Sets map mode to MAP, 3D or PREVIEW.

command.name: setEditorObjectScope
command.description: This command defines the level of access a user has to editor objects. objects is an array of either Editor Objects (eg [_unit_0]) or actual Game Objects (eg [player]). If the array is empty then the command will automatically parse all editor objects. editor type is the editor type to effect (eg unit), or for none. condition is an executable string that must evaluate to true or false. If true, the scope of the evaluated editor object will be modified. scope is one of HIDE, VIEW, SELECT, LINKTO, LINKFROM, ALLNODRAG, ALLNOTREE or ALL. subordinates also is a boolean value, if true then subordinates in the editor will be assigned the same scope as the parent.

command.name: setEffectCondition
command.description: The statement is executed when the trigger or waypoint is activated and the effects are launched depending on the result. If the result is a boolean and true, the effect was launched. If the result is an object, the effect was launched if the result is the player or the player vehicle. If the result is an array, the effect was launched if the result contains the player or the player vehicle.

command.name: setFace
command.description: Sets the person's face.

command.name: setFaceanimation
command.description: Sets the facial animation phase (eye blinking). Blink is in the range from 0 to 1.

command.name: setFlagTexture
command.description: Sets the flag texture. If the texture is "", the flag is not drawn.

command.name: setFog
command.description: Changes the fog value smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means there will be an immediate change. A fog level of zero is minimum fog and a fog level of one is maximum fog.

command.name: setFormation
command.description: Set a new formation to given team.

command.name: setFromEditor
command.description: Set if given team member was inserted directly from editor.

command.name: setFSMVariable
command.description: Set variable to given value in the variable space of given FSM. The FSM handle is the number returned by the execFSM command.

command.name: setFuel
command.description: Sets the fuel amount. A fuel level of one is a full gas tank.

command.name: setFuelCargo
command.description: Sets the fuel amount in the cargo space of a refuelling vehicle. A fuel level of one is a full gas tank.

command.name: setHazeDistCoef
command.description: Sets coef used to compute haze distance (haze distance = farFog * coef). Set to negative value to compute haze in standard way.

command.name: setHazeFogCoef
command.description: Sets wanted fog coef for haze at haze distance (0=full fog, 1 = no fog). Set to negative value to compute haze in standard way.

command.name: setHDRLuminanceRectCoef
command.description: Sets coefficient that is used to determine rectangle, which HDR luminance is computed from. Set to negative value to use automatic values from light config.

command.name: setHideBehind
command.description: It sets the data for hiding. ObjectWhereHide can be taken using findCover. HidePosition can be taken using getHideFrom.

command.name: setHit
command.description: Damage / repair part of object. Damage 0 means fully functional, damage 1 means completely destroyed / dead.

command.name: setHitPointDamage
command.description: Damage / repair part of object. Damage 0 means fully functional, damage 1 means completely destroyed / dead. Use name of hit point.

command.name: setHUDMovementLevels
command.roper: [min speed, max speed, min alt, max alt, min dir, max dir, position[x,y,z] or target]
command.description: Set min/max movement borders displayed in HUD gauges. Use -1 to skip some value.Speed [m/s],alt [m], dir [deg]. Use [-1,-1,-1] to keep current position

command.name: setIdentity
command.description: Sets the identity of a person. Identities are defined in the descripion.ext file of the mission or campaign.

command.name: setImportance
command.description: Set a new importance of given location.

command.name: setLeader
command.description: Set the leader of given team.

command.name: setLightAmbient
command.description: Set ambient color of light.

command.name: setLightBrightness
command.description: Set brightness of light.

command.name: setLightColor
command.description: Set diffuse color of light.

command.name: setMagazineAmmo
command.description: Set the ammo count of given magazine.

command.name: setMarkerAlpha
command.description: Sets the marker alpha. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerAlphaLocal
command.description: Sets the marker alpha. The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerBrush
command.description: Selects the fill texture for the marker ("RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE"). Brush is the name of the subclass in CfgMarkerBrushes. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerBrushLocal
command.description: Selects the fill texture for the marker ("RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE"). Brush is the name of the subclass in CfgMarkerBrushes. The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerColor
command.description: Sets the marker color. Color is one of: "Default", "ColorBlack", "ColorRed", "ColorRedAlpha", "ColorGreen", "ColorGreenAlpha", "ColorBlue", "ColorYellow" or "ColorWhite". The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerColorLocal
command.description: Sets the marker color. Color is one of: "Default", "ColorBlack", "ColorRed", "ColorRedAlpha", "ColorGreen", "ColorGreenAlpha", "ColorBlue", "ColorYellow" or "ColorWhite". The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerDir
command.description: Sets the orientation of the marker. Angle is in degrees. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerDirLocal
command.description: Sets the orientation of the marker. Angle is in degrees. The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerPos
command.description: Moves the marker. The format of pos is Position2D. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerPosLocal
command.description: Moves the marker. The format of pos is Position2D. The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerShape
command.description: Selects the shape (type) of the marker. Shape can be "ICON", "RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE". The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerShapeLocal
command.description: Selects the shape (type) of the marker. Shape can be "ICON", "RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE". The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerSize
command.description: Sets the marker size. Size is in format [a-axis, b-axis]. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerSizeLocal
command.description: Sets the marker size. Size is in format [a-axis, b-axis]. The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerText
command.description: Sets the text label of an existing marker. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerTextLocal
command.description: Sets the text label of an existing marker. The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerType
command.description: Sets the marker type. Type may be any of: "Flag", "Flag1", "Dot", "Destroy", "Start", "End", "Warning", "Join", "Pickup", "Unknown", "Marker", "Arrow" or "Empty". The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerTypeLocal
command.description: Sets the marker type. Type may be any of: "Flag", "Flag1", "Dot", "Destroy", "Start", "End", "Warning", "Join", "Pickup", "Unknown", "Marker", "Arrow" or "Empty". The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMimic
command.description: Sets a unit's mimic. The following values are recognized: "Default", "Normal", "Smile", "Hurt", "Ironic", "Sad", "Cynic", "Surprised", "Agresive" and "Angry".

command.name: setMousePosition
command.description: Move (UI) mouse pointer to specified position of the screen.

command.name: setMusicEffect
command.description: Defines the music track played on activation. Track is a subclass name of CfgMusic. "$NONE$" (no change) or "$STOP$" (stops the current music track).

command.name: setName
command.description: Set which global variable will contain given location.

command.name: setObjectArguments
command.description: Set object arguments in mission editor.

command.name: setObjectProxy
command.description: Set the proxy object associated with the given editor object.

command.name: setObjectViewDistance
command.description: Sets the rendering distance of objects.

command.name: setObjectViewDistance
command.description: Sets the rendering distance of objects.

command.name: setOvercast
command.description: Changes the overcast level to the given value smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means an immediate change. An overcast level of zero means clear (sunny) weather and with an overcast level of one, storms and showers are very likely.

command.name: setOwner
command.description: On server machine, change the ownership of object to a given client. Returns true if locality was changed.

command.name: setParticleCircle
command.description: Update particle source to create particles on circle with given radius. Velocity is transformed and added to total velocity.

command.name: setParticleParams
command.description: Set parameters to particle source. Array is in format ParticleArray.

command.name: setParticleRandom
command.roper: [lifeTime, position, moveVelocity, rotationVelocity, size, color, randomDirectionPeriod, randomDirectionIntensity, {angle}]
command.description: Set randomization of particle source parameters.

command.name: setPos
command.description: Sets the object position. The pos array uses the Position format.
command.example: player setPos [getpos player select 0, getpos player select 1 + 10]

command.name: setPosASL
command.description: Sets the object position. The pos array uses the PositionASL format.
command.example: player setPosASL [getPosASL player select 0, getPosASL player select 1 + 10, getPosASL select 2]

command.name: setPosASL2
command.description: Sets the object position. The pos array uses the PositionASL format. The version of the command does not offset based on object center.

command.name: setPosATL
command.description: Sets the object position. The pos array uses the PositionATL format.
command.example: player setPosASL [getPosATL player select 0, getPosATL player select 1 + 10, getPosATL select 2]

command.name: setPosition
command.description: Set a new position of given location.

command.name: setRadioMsg
command.description: Sets the radio message (0, 0, map radio) to the given text. Use "NULL" to disable the radio slot.

command.name: setRain
command.description: Changes the rain density smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means an immediate change. A rain level of zero is no rain and a rain level of one is maximum rain. Rain is not possible when overcast is smaller than 0.7.

command.name: setRank
command.description: Sets rank of given unit. Possible values: PRIVATE, CORPORAL, SERGEANT, LIEUTENANT, CAPTAIN, MAJOR or COLONEL.

command.name: setRectangular
command.description: Set if given location has rectangular shape.

command.name: setRepairCargo
command.description: Sets the amount or repair resources in the cargo space of a repair vehicle. An amount of one is a full cargo space.

command.name: setSatNormalMapBlendPars
command.description: Sets the satellite normal map blend pars.

command.name: setShadowDistance
command.description: Sets the shadows rendering distance.

command.name: setSide
command.description: Set a new target side of given location.

command.name: setSimpleTaskDescription
command.description: Attach descriptions to the simple task.

command.name: setSimpleTaskDestination
command.description: Attach a destination to the simple task. Overrides setSimpleTaskTarget.

command.name: setSimpleTaskTarget
command.description: Attach a target to the simple task. Overrides setSimpleTaskDestination.

command.name: setSize
command.description: Set a new size (width, height) of given location.

command.name: setSkill
command.description: Sets skill of given type of person (commander unit). Value of skill may vary from 0 to 1.

command.name: setSkill
command.description: Sets ability levell of person (commander unit). Value of skill may vary from 0 to 1.

command.name: setSoundEffect
command.description: Defines the different sound effects. Sound / voice plays a 2D / 3D sound from CfgSounds. SoundEnv plays an enviromental sound from CfgEnvSounds. SoundDet (only for triggers) creates a dynamic sound object attached to a trigger defined in CfgSFX.

command.name: setSystemOfUnits
command.description: Set system of units. 0 for metric, 1 for mixed, 2 for imperial.

command.name: setTargetCategory
command.description: Set target category for setTargetDistanceLimit

command.name: setTargetDistanceLimit
command.description: Set target tracking limit for a given unit for all target categories

command.name: setTargetDistanceLimit
command.description: Set target tracking limit for a given unit and target category

command.name: setTaskResult
command.description: Set a result of the task.

command.name: setTaskState
command.description: Set a new state of the task.

command.name: setTerrainGrid
command.description: Sets the desired terrain resolution (in meters). For default landscapes the supported resolutions are: 50, 25, 12.5, 6.25 and 3.125. If you select an unsupported resolution, the nearest supported resolution is used instead.

command.name: setText
command.description: Set a new text attached to given location.

command.name: setTimeForScripts
command.description: Temporarily set the new time limit for scripts simulation. Parameter is in seconds.

command.name: setTitleEffect
command.description: Defines the title effect. Type can be "NONE", "OBJECT", "RES" or "TEXT". For "TEXT", the effect defines a subtype: "PLAIN", "PLAIN DOWN", "BLACK", "BLACK FADED", "BLACK OUT", "BLACK IN", "WHITE OUT" or "WHITE IN". Text is shown as text itself. For "OBJECT", text defines the shown object, a subclass of CfgTitles. For "RES", text defines a resource class, a subclass of RscTitles.

command.name: setToneMapping
command.description: Set tone mapping method

command.name: setToneMappingParams
command.description: Set tone mapping parameters

command.name: setTriggerActivation
command.description: Defines the trigger activation type. The first argument - who activates trigger (side, radio, vehicle or group member): "NONE", "EAST", "WEST", "GUER", "CIV", "LOGIC", "ANY", "ALPHA", "BRAVO", "CHARLIE", "DELTA", "ECHO", "FOXTROT", "GOLF", "HOTEL", "INDIA", "JULIET", "STATIC", "VEHICLE", "GROUP", "LEADER" or "MEMBER". The second argument - when is it activated (presention or detection by the specified side): "PRESENT", "NOT PRESENT", "WEST D", "EAST D", "GUER D" or "CIV D". The third argument - whether the activation is repeating.

command.name: setTriggerArea
command.description: Defines the area controlled by the trigger. The area is rectangular or elliptic, the width is 2 * a, the height is 2 * b. It is rotated angle degrees.

command.name: setTriggerStatements
command.description: The first argument can modify the condition of when the trigger is activated. The result of the activation defined by trigger activation is in variable this. Variable thisList contains all vehicles which caused the activation. Activ and desactiv expressions are launched upon trigger activation / deactivation.

command.name: setTriggerText
command.description: Sets the text label attached to the trigger object. This is used for example as a radio slot label for radio activated triggers.

command.name: setTriggerTimeout
command.description: Defines the time between condition satisfaction and trigger activation (randomly from min to max, with an average value mid). If the last argument is true, the condition must be fullfilled all the time.

command.name: setTriggerType
command.description: Sets the type of action processed by the trigger after activation (no action, a waypoints switch or an end of mission): "NONE", "SWITCH", "END1", "END2", "END3", "END4", "END5", "END6", "LOOSE" or "WIN".

command.name: setType
command.description: Set a new type of given location.

command.name: setUnconscious
command.description: Set / reset the unconscious life state of the given unit (in MP works only for a local unit).

command.name: setUnitAbility
command.description: Sets skill of given unit. Skill may vary from 0.2 to 1.0.

command.name: setUnitPos
command.description: Sets the unit position rules. Mode may be one of: "DOWN", "UP" or "AUTO".

command.name: setUnitPosWeak
command.description: Equal to setUnitPos, for usage in formation FSM (to avoid collision with setUnitPos used by the mission).

command.name: setUnitRank
command.description: Sets rank of given unit. Possible values: PRIVATE, CORPORAL, SERGEANT, LIEUTENANT, CAPTAIN, MAJOR or COLONEL.

command.name: setUnitRecoilCoefficient
command.description: Proportionaly increase/decrease unit's recoil.

command.name: setUserActionText
command.description: Change action texts

command.name: setVariable
command.description: Set variable to given value in the variable space of given team member. If public is true then the value is broadcast to all computers.

command.name: setVariable
command.description: Set variable to given value in the variable space of given location.

command.name: setVariable
command.description: Set variable to given value in the variable space of given object. If public is true then the value is broadcast to all computers.

command.name: setVariable
command.description: Set variable to given value in the variable space of given map.

command.name: setVariable
command.description: Set variable to given value in the variable space of given task.

command.name: setVariable
command.description: Set variable to given value in the given namespace.

command.name: setVectorDir
command.description: Set object's direction vector. Up vector will remain unchanged.

command.name: setVectorDirAndUp
command.description: Set object's direction and up vector

command.name: setVectorUp
command.description: Set object's up vector. Direction vector will remain unchanged.

command.name: setVehicleAmmo
command.description: Sets how much ammunition (compared to the current configuration of magazines, but fully loaded) the vehicle has. The value ranges from 0 to 1.

command.name: setVehicleArmor
command.description: Sets the armor (or health for men) state of the vehicle (a value from 0 to 1).

command.name: setVehicleId
command.description: Sets id (integer value) to vehicle. By this id vehicle is referenced by triggers and waypoints.

command.name: setVehicleInit
command.description: Execute statement attached to vehicle. This statement is also propagated over network in MP games.

command.name: setVehicleLock
command.description: Set how vehicle is locked for player. Possible values: UNLOCKED, DEFAULT or LOCKED.

command.name: setVehiclePosition
command.description: Changes the object position. If the markers array contains more than one marker names, the position of a random one is used. Otherwise, the given position is used. The object is placed inside a circle with this position as its center and placement as its radius.

command.name: setVehicleTiPars
command.description: Set ti parameters for specified vehicle, pars: engine/body, tracks/wheels, main gun.

command.name: setVehicleVarName
command.description: Sets the name of the variable which contains a reference to this object. It is necessary in MP to change the variable content after a respawn.

command.name: setVelocity
command.description: Sets the velocity (speed vector) of a vehicle.

command.name: setVelocityTransformation
command.roper: [position1, position2, velocity1, velocity2, direction1, direction2, up1, up2, time]
command.description: interpolates and sets vectors. Time has to be from <0,1>

command.name: setViewDistance
command.description: Sets the rendering distance. Default is 900 meters. The accepted range is from 500 to 5000 meters.

command.name: setVisibleIfTreeCollapsed
command.description: Sets whether or not the object is visible even if the tree is collapsed.

command.name: setWeaponReloadingTime
command.description: Set states and/or makes an action of/on weapon. ReloadTime goes from 0 to 1, where 1 is 100 percent of max reloading time.

command.name: setWind
command.description: Set current (forced == false) or permanent (forced == true) wind direction and force.

command.name: setWindForce
command.description: Set max. wind overall wind changes in time. A time of zero means there will be an immediate change. A wind level of zero is minimal changes and a wind level of one means that wind can chage rapidly and max. wind speed i 35m/s.

command.name: show3DIcons
command.description: Toggle the drawing of 3D icons.

command.name: showCinemaBorder
command.description: Forces drawing of the cinema borders. This is normally used in cutscenes to indicate the player has no control.

command.name: showGps
command.description: Enables the GPS receiver (the default is false).

command.name: showHUD
command.description: Enable / disable showing of HUD.

command.name: showLegend
command.description: Show/hide map legend.

command.name: showMap
command.description: Enables the map (the default is true).

command.name: showNewEditorObject
command.description: Show the add editor object dialog, type is editor object type, class is class definition to automatically select, side filters by a certain side, pos is position to create the object.

command.name: shownGps
command.description: Checks whether the player has the GPS receiver enabled.

command.name: shownMap
command.description: Checks whether the player has the map enabled.

command.name: shownPad
command.description: Checks whether the player has the notebook enabled.

command.name: shownRadio
command.description: Checks whether the player has the radio transmitter enabled.

command.name: shownWarrant
command.description: Checks whether the player has the ID card enabled. (Obsolete).

command.name: showPad
command.description: Enables the notepad (the default is true).

command.name: showRadio
command.description: Enables the radio (the default is false).

command.name: showSubtitles
command.description: Enable / disable showing of subtitles. Return the previous state.

command.name: showWarrant
command.description: Obsolete. Enables the ID card (the default is false).

command.name: side
command.description: Returns the side of the unit.

command.name: side
command.description: Return target side of given location.

command.name: sideEnemy
command.description: The Enemy side (used for renegades).

command.name: sideFriendly
command.description: The Friendly side (used for captives).

command.name: sideLogic
command.description: The Logic side.

command.name: sideUnknown
command.description: The unknown side.

command.name: simpleTasks
command.description: Return all simple tasks assigned to given person.

command.name: simulationEnabled
command.description: Check if the entity has enabled simulation.

command.name: sin
command.description: The sine of x, the argument is in degrees.

command.name: size
command.description: Return size of given location (width, height).

command.name: sizeOf
command.description: Return the size of the entity of given type.

command.name: skill
command.description: Returns the current level of ability of the person.

command.name: skill
command.description: Returns skill of given type of person (commander unit). Value of skill may vary from 0 to 1.

command.name: skipTime
command.description: Skips the specified time. Daytime is adjusted, a weather change is estimated and no changes to any units are done. Duration is in hours.

command.name: sleep
command.description: Suspend execution of script for given time.

command.name: sliderPosition
command.description: Returns the current thumb position of the slider with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: sliderPosition
command.description: Returns the current thumb position of the given slider.

command.name: sliderRange
command.description: Returns the limits (as an array [min, max]) of the slider with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: sliderRange
command.description: Returns the limits (as an array [min, max]) of the given slider.

command.name: sliderSetPosition
command.description: Sets the current thumb position of the slider with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: sliderSetPosition
command.description: Sets the current thumb position of the given slider.

command.name: sliderSetRange
command.description: Sets the limits of the slider with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: sliderSetRange
command.description: Sets the limits of the slider with id idc of the given slider.

command.name: sliderSetSpeed
command.description: Sets the speed (a click on the arrow results in a move per line. A click on the scale outside the thumb results in a move per page) of the slider with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: sliderSetSpeed
command.description: Sets the speed (a click on the arrow results in a move per line. A click on the scale outside the thumb results in a move per page) of the given slider.

command.name: sliderSpeed
command.description: Returns the speed (as an array [line, page]) of the given slider.

command.name: sliderSpeed
command.description: Returns the speed (as an array [line, page]) of the slider with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: someAmmo
command.description: Checks whether the unit has some ammo remaining.

command.name: soundVolume
command.description: Checks the current sound volume (set by setSoundVolume).

command.name: spawn
command.description: Executes a script. Argument is passed to the script as local variable _this.

command.name: spawnForPlayer
command.description: Execute given code on a client owning the player. Intended to control local effects for the player, like camera or UI

command.name: spawnForPlayer
command.description: Execute given code on a client owning the player. Intended to control local effects for the player, like camera or UI

command.name: speed
command.description: Returns the object speed (in km/h).

command.name: sqrt
command.description: The square root of x.

command.name: startLoadingScreen
command.description: Shows loading screen with the given text, using the given resource. When loading screen is shown, simulation and scene drawing is disabled, scripts run at full speed.

command.name: statusChat
command.description: Types text to the status. Note: this function only types text to the list, it does not broadcast the message. If you want the message to show on all computers, you have to execute it on all of them.

command.name: statusChat
command.description: On server machine, type the status text on the given client.
command.example: (owner agent007) statusChat "Feels tired"; (owner agent007) statusChat ["Never tired!","colorImportant"]

command.name: step
command.description: Optionaly can set step. If you want to count down, step must be specified, and set negative. Default value is 1.

command.name: stop
command.description: Stops an AI unit. This function is obsolete. Use disableAI to get better control over stopping a unit.

command.name: stopped
command.description: Checks whether the unit is stopped using the "stop" command.

command.name: str
command.description: Converts any variable to a string.

command.name: sunOrMoon
command.description: Returns sun to moon transition state.

command.name: supportInfo
command.description: Creates list of supported operators and type. Each field of array has format: "x:name" where x is 't' - type, 'n' - nullary operator, 'u' - unary operator, 'b' - binary operator. 'name' is operator's/type's name (in case operator, type of input operands is included). `mask` parameter can be empty string, or one of field. In this case, function returns empty array, if operator is not included in list. `mask` can contain wildcards, for example: *:name, t:*, t:name* or *:*.

command.name: suppressFor
command.description: Makes the unit to apply suppressive fire on known enemies.

command.name: surfaceIsWater

array.name: ParticleArray
array.format: [ShapeName, AnimationName, Type, TimerPeriod, LifeTime, Position, MoveVelocity, RotationVelocity, Weight, Volume, Rubbing, Size, Color, AnimationPhase, RandomDirectionPeriod, RandomDirectionIntensity, OnTimer, BeforeDestroy, Object, {angle}]
array.description: Global parameters: ShapeName - Name of the shape associated with the particle. AnimationName - Name of the animation of the shape. Type - Type of the particle (either "Billboard" or "SpaceObject"). TimerPeriod - The period of calling the "OnTimer" event (in sec). LifeTime - Life time of the particle (in sec). Physical parameters: Position - Either 3D coordinate (xzy) or name of the selection - in this case the Object property must be set. MoveVelocity - 3D vector (xyz) which describes the velocity vector of the particle (direction and speed in m/s). RotationVelocity - Float number which determines number of rotations in one second. Weight - Weight of the particle (in kg). Volume - Volume of the particle (in m^3). Rubbing - Float number without dimension which determines the impact of the density od the enviroment on this particle. 0 - no impact (vacuum). Render parameters: Note that all these values are set as arrays to show their development in time. F.I. if you set the array [1,2] as a size then at the beginning the size of the particle will be 1 and at the end of the life time of the particle it's size will be 2. The rest od the values during the life time will be lineary interpolated. Size - Size of the particle in time to render (m). Color - Color of the particle in time to render (RGBA). AnimationPhase - Phase of the animation in time. Random parameters: RandomDirectionPeriod - Period of changing the velocity vector (s). RandomDirectionIntensity - Each MoveVelocity component will be changed with random value from interval <0, RandomDirectionIntensity>. OnTimer - Name of the script to run every period determined by TimerPeriod property. Position of the particle is stored in "this" variable. BeforeDestroy - Name of the script to run right before destroying the particle. Position of the particle is stored in "this" variable. Object - Object to bind this particle to.
